scene_full.prompt: Bright, airy, light-filled photorealistic interior photograph of an organic modern kitchen, large waterfall island with bar stools. The hero is the countertop: Calacatta Dolce quartz (creamy white quartz with delicate taupe veins), 3cm thick, a high-gloss polished surface with a clean eased edge, shown in full with no cropped ends or corners. The same stone runs as a full-height slab backsplash behind the range, veining flowing continuously from countertop to backsplash. Greige painted shaker cabinets with brushed stainless hardware, bright soft morning daylight from large windows. Light walls, styled minimally (a bowl of lemons, a small vase of greenery, a cutting board). Clean bright exposure, fresh and stunning, uncluttered, real materials and true-to-life reflections, eye-level architectural photography, 24-35mm lens, magazine quality. Tall vertical 9:16 composition: the stone surface sits in the vertical middle of the frame and spans no more than 85% of the width, with generous space above and below, so the image can also be cropped to 4:5 and 1:1 around it. Quiet, low-detail upper corners. No people, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
